subject: Basalt status: repro green, novel-category gap
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Basalt status. Training repro is green for r50 and r50x4 — the detector head converges in under a day on 128 A100s with the frozen backbone, as advertised. The r50x16 FLAX checkpoint restore is fixed (shape mismatch in our loader, not in the release).

Benchmark: on the internal category list, r50x4 posts a strong base-category score but novel-category recall trails by about 9 points — expected behavior for open-vocabulary detection, and prompt engineering on the category names recovers roughly 3 of those points.

Risk for the demo: r50x16 inference latency is 2.8x r50x4 for maybe two points of quality. Recommend we demo r50x4.

Umar
